title: TRACEAI Data Record Schema
description: Schema defining the structure of a TRACEAI provenance metadata record.

field_ownership.note: Fields in data_layer_fields are created and owned by the data layer. Fields in downstream_generated_fields are populated by the AI/integration layer at ingestion time and must NOT be fabricated in the data layer.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for the record. Must be unique across the entire dataset.

file_name.description: Filename of the data asset (basename only, no path).

file_path.description: Relative file path from the repository root.

record_type.description: Modality of the record. Must match the actual file type.

source.description: Human-readable description of the origin of this record.

source_type.description: Type classification of the source. Use synthetic for project-created records.

source_url.description: URL of the external source if applicable. null for synthetic records.

license.description: Licence associated with this record. Do not claim unverified licences.
license.mutable_note: May be updated if licence is later verified or corrected.

license_verified.description: Whether the licence claim has been verified. True ONLY for project-created synthetic data or when external licence is confirmed.
license_verified.mutable_note: May be updated after external verification.

dataset.description: Name of the dataset this record belongs to.

dataset_version.description: Version of the dataset this record belongs to.
dataset_version.mutable_note: Updated when the record is migrated to a new dataset version.

transformation.description: Description of the transformation history applied to this record.

parent_record.description: record_id of the parent record if this is a derived record. null for root records.

created_at.description: Creation date in ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD format.

similarity_demo_category.description: DEMO ONLY -- Intended provenance review category for demonstration purposes. NOT a legal conclusion. HIGH means requires provenance/licence review.

similarity_demo_note.description: DEMO ONLY -- Explanation of the similarity category for this record.

notes.description: Free-text additional notes about this record.

sha256.description: DOWNSTREAM FIELD -- SHA-256 hash of the file bytes, prefixed sha256:<hex>. Calculated by the ingestion gateway at runtime. Must NOT be pre-populated with fabricated values in the data layer.

phash.description: DOWNSTREAM FIELD -- Perceptual hash (pHash) for image records only. Calculated by the AI/image track at runtime. Must NOT be pre-populated with fabricated values in the data layer.

embedding_id.description: DOWNSTREAM FIELD -- FAISS/vector store embedding ID assigned at indexing time. Must NOT be pre-populated with fabricated values in the data layer.
